ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using Windows Media Player - File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using Windows Media Player osksupport.dll (UACMe 32)

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND file_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\OskSupport\\\.dll$")) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\DllHost\.exe" AND file_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Windows\ Media\ Player\\osk\.exe"))
